FIELDS.NAME: Clearview Glass & Window Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Clearview Glass & Window Solutions specializes in providing high-quality residential glass and window services, including installation, repair, and replacement of various glass types. Our operations focus primarily on low-rise residential buildings, ensuring a safe working environment with minimal risk of catastrophic loss. We are committed to maintaining a strong safety culture, which includes documented safety protocols and regular training for our employees. Our team directly handles most work, ensuring quality control and client satisfaction. We also prioritize compliance with local building codes and regulations in all our services. Our efficient logistics ensure secure transportation of glass materials, underscored by a well-documented vehicle maintenance program. With a clean loss history and a focus on residential clients, we strive to deliver reliable and professional glass solutions to our community.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, during the installation of a residential window, a light wind caused a glass panel to slip from the lift, resulting in a minor breakage. The total loss incurred was $1,200. The incident has been resolved, and the broken panel has been fully replaced.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM; closed on Sunday.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1 Safe, Standard Grade, Approved Label
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols during evening hours to ensure the safety of the premises.
